name: experiment-learning
description: Short learning sessions during explicit local experiment waits in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Use short learning cards while a local experiment is running and the main Codex is explicitly waiting for results. A separate learning conversation keeps explanations and progress together. The local Python monitor checks process identity, elapsed time and waiting markers without calling a model while polling. Card delivery and learning replies use your signed-in Codex account. Windows only; requires Python, a complete native Codex CLI with queue support and a running local daemon. Project integration and desktop-open startup are opt-in. Remote jobs, phone delivery and other history formats are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Set up a separate learning conversation for my experiment waits.
Run my local evaluation and offer a learning card when I am waiting.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.1: Desktop-only skills metadata and verified public policy/support pages; complete-CLI selection and read-only daemon diagnostics; explicit backend startup; validated cards and recovery controls; separate upload ZIP; 20 offline tests plus real native success/failure and temporary installation acceptance.

prompts: Set up a separate learning conversation and verify the connection before enabling reminders.
Run my long local evaluation with its original arguments, then offer a short card when I am actually waiting.
Import my own JSON learning cards and check their prerequisites.
Pause learning reminders without stopping my experiment.
Can this monitor a job submitted over SSH? Explain the supported scope before taking action.
review.commerce_description: This plugin does not charge plugin fees, sell products, process payments or provide a purchase flow. Codex account usage remains subject to the user account plan and limits.
